descrizione: The Last Airbender is a 2010 American fantasy action-adventure film based on the first season of the animated television series, Avatar: The Last Airbender (2005–2008). Written and directed by M. Night Shyamalan , the film stars an ensemble cast featuring an array of young actors and is known for its ambitious story of elemental manipulation and heroism.

recensioni.estratto: The movie was dry, the acting was horrible, and the mood was bleak. The way the bending is portrayed is enough to ruin the movie.
The movie is "Star Wars" with martial arts, plus a touch of "The Last Emperor." Technically, it's not badly done; I enjoyed the physical clash of elements.
This film has awful acting, terrible special effects, an awful story, and on top of that, they completely messed up the characters names.
From the terribly written and wooden dialogue, to complete lack of fun that made the show so enjoyable.
The film has good cinematography and good colors, but the action scenes and martial arts fights are exaggerated to the point of absurdity.
This empty, misfired epic from M. Night Shyamalan is boring and strengthens the claim that he is the worst director working in mainstream cinema today.
